program.section_heading: Piano Performance - Certificate of Achievement - CE925
outcomes: Prepare, and perform in, a solo piano recital and/or chamber ensemble performance. This will include but is not limited to, literature selection and preparation, collaboration with other musicians and written program development.

Demonstrate practice and preparation skills required for music transfer students and/or professional musician. Skills will include but are not limited to, successfully performing scales, arpeggios, exercises, and études.
Communicate effectively and work cooperatively within an ensemble setting.

notes: MUS-P12 is printed four times in the Required Courses table with the note '* Course must be taken four times' (4 x 3.00 = 12.00 units, plus MUS-52 0.50 = 12.50 stated). It is recorded once here at 3 units per enrollment; a reviewer should note the four-time repetition requirement.
Elective Courses note reads 'Course must be repeated up to four times.' The 6 units are read as choose_units 6 from MUS-P36 and MUS-36 (1.5 units each), reached by repeating the ensemble courses.
MUS-P36 (Piano Ensemble) is not in the closed list and is marked as a catalog addition.
The catalog prints Total: 18.50 for the certificate.
